title: World Facts & Geography
notes:
World at a Glance

  • Largest continent: Asia · Smallest: Australia.
  • Largest ocean: Pacific · Deepest point: Mariana Trench (Challenger Deep, ~10,935 m).
  • Longest river: Nile (~6,650 km) · Largest river by discharge: Amazon.
  • Highest mountain: Mount Everest (8,848.86 m) · Lowest point on land: Dead Sea.
  • Largest country by area: Russia · Largest by population (2026): India.
  • Most populous city: Tokyo · Largest desert: Antarctic (cold), Sahara (hot).
  • Greenhouse effect driver: CO₂ from fossil fuels; Largest rainforest: Amazon Basin.

International Organizations

  • UN: founded 24 October 1945, headquarters New York; Secretary-General (2026): António Guterres (Portugal, term ends 2026).
  • SAARC: founded 1985, headquarters Kathmandu.
  • ASEAN, EU, AU, G20, BRICS: major regional/global groupings.
